children.body: Sample chapter: the smallest habitat-book fixture

The smallest possible habitat book chapter. A Nopales example
evaluates live in the reader's session:

```nopales
(+ 1 2)
```
expect => 3

An OCaml example is captured at render time only (no live OCaml
evaluator in v1):

```ocaml
let double x = x * 2
```

Prose after the fences rides through untouched.
